phrases.text: The first jet airliner, the Comet, had square-cornered windows.
Every flight, the cabin is pumped full of air.
The metal stretches, again and again,
and at a sharp corner, the stress piles up.
In 1954, those square corners cracked, and two Comets broke apart mid-flight.
So windows were made round, and the stress flows around them.
That's why your window has round corners.
